item.title: Trump carries out overnight strike on Venezuela, captures Maduro and his wife
item.description: The US launched a large-scale strike against Venezuela, capturing President Nicolás Maduro and his wife, and flying them out of the country, prompting Colombia to prepare for a potential influx of refugees and Russia to condemn the US action as an act of armed aggression.

item.title: Colts’ 2026 regular season opponents finalized
item.description: The Colts' 2026 regular season opponents have been finalized following the final week of the 2025 regular season.

item.title: Indiana lawmakers react to U.S. strikes on Venezuela, capture of Maduro
item.description: Indiana's congressional delegation has expressed a range of reactions to the U.S. capture of Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro, with some expressing support and others questioning the legality of the military action.

item.title: Shane Steichen, Chris Ballard to return to Colts for 2026 season
item.description: The Colts have decided to retain head coach Shane Steichen and general manager Chris Ballard for the 2026 season, despite not making the playoffs for the fifth straight year.

item.title: Bill would require all Indiana classrooms to display Ten Commandments
item.description: A group of Indiana Republicans have introduced a bill that would require all public schools in the state to display the Ten Commandments in every library and classroom.

item.title: Colts fall to Texans, end season on seven-game losing streak
item.description: The Colts lost to the Texans 38-30, ending the season on a seven-game losing streak.

item.title: Colts say GM and head coach are returning, fans sound off
item.description: Fans of the Indianapolis Colts are expressing frustration with the team's performance and are hoping for improvements and a more consistent approach in the off-season.
